title: What holds a cube together?
question: How can a body yield while keeping relations between its parts?
rule:
SoftBody3D updates vertices under stiffness, damping and pressure.
The triangle connections remain. A changed shape need not change topology.
MILL holds the drive; the soft sphere still responds to physics.

title: Which points must stay?
question: How does fixing a boundary change the forms a surface can take?
rule:
PINS changes which cloth vertices cannot move.
SUPPORT changes the frame the strips appear to hang from.
RELEASE removes the pins. REBUILD starts fresh strips.
LANDING changes the obstruction under four falling spheres.
Those spheres are a comparison, not woven cloth.

title: The support moves
question: What changes when the constraint itself is driven?
rule:
The hub is driven at a prescribed angular rate.
Joints and soft bodies respond; they do not choose that rate.
STOP removes the drive, not gravity or all motion.

title: The room has a body
question: What happens when the enclosing architecture deforms?
rule:
P = (sin(time) + 1) * amplitude / 2.
The sine drives pressure, then the soft solver responds.
HOLD DRIVE holds pressure while physics continues.
The room does not sense or decide to breathe.

title: Same fall, another encounter
question: Which differences belong to material, contact geometry and experimental variation?
rule:
The gallery varies mesh, obstruction and material settings.
Seed 1337; optional extra material jitter is off initially.
HOLD pins current points. It does not discover a final shape.
Choose a named comparison before generalizing.

title: When does a body become a form?
question: What does a frozen surface keep of the process that made it?
rule:
MEASURE changes the reading; FEEDBACK adjusts pressure.
The volume proxy is a box aligned with the world axes.
Feedback off restores selected pressure, not a previous shape.
DURATION keeps a different moment as a collidable closed skin.

title: What makes this look alive?
question: What can the image of a living body tell us about the mechanism?
rule:
Spheres, rings, lattices and spikes are constructed by recipes.
Colour, rotation and glow change the encounter.
They do not turn this geometry into a biological simulation.
What mechanism does the resemblance invite you to imagine?

title: A pattern has a metabolism
question: How can local exchanges maintain a spatial difference?
rule:
Gray-Scott: uvv = u * v * v.
Diffusion exchanges concentrations; feed and kill replenish/remove.
Read the old arrays, then swap buffers.
A 2D chemical field is not yet a deforming solid.

title: Who connected the controls?
question: Does a parameter named entropy measure disorder, or prescribe a family of forms?
rule:
S interpolates frequency and noise, and shifts the threshold.
It is not computed from a probability distribution.
Changing resolution changes the sampled surface.
An authored coupling is a choice we can separate and test.
